python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
for name in ('docs/features/payments.md', 'docs/runbooks/gateway-timeouts.md'):
    page = Path(name)
    for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', page.read_text()):
        path, _, anchor = target.partition('#')
        destination = page.parent / path if path else page
        assert destination.is_file(), (name, target)
        if anchor:
            headings = [re.sub(r'[^\w -]', '', h.lower()).replace(' ', '-') for h in re.findall(r'^#+ (.+)$', destination.read_text(), re.M)]
            assert anchor in headings, (name, target)
print('Documentation links and anchors resolve.')
PY
